server_name.description: Hostname or identifier for this HylaFAX server (used in logs and headers).

country_code.description: International dialing country code (e.g., 1 for US/Canada).

area_code.description: Local area code for local dialing rules.

fax_number.description: Primary fax number for this server (E.164 format recommended).

long_distance_prefix.description: Prefix to dial for long-distance calls (e.g., '1' in North America).

international_prefix.description: Prefix to dial for international calls (e.g., '011' in North America).

dial_string_rules.description: Name of the dial string rules file (relative to DialRulesDir).

modem_type.description: Default modem type for devices not explicitly listed in modems.

modem_speed.description: Default maximum modem speed (bps) for outbound calls.

dev_dir.description: Directory where modem device symlinks are created.

run_dir.description: Runtime directory for status and lock files.

spool_dir.description: Root spool directory for job queues and configuration.

require_pin.description: Require PIN authentication for incoming fax calls.

allow_calls_from.description: List of allowed calling party numbers (wildcards supported). Empty list blocks all. Use '*' to allow all.

deny_calls_from.description: List of blocked calling party numbers (e.g., private lines, known spammers).

max_concurrent_calls.description: Maximum number of simultaneous fax calls (inbound or outbound).

max_retries.description: Number of retry attempts for failed outgoing calls.

retry_delay.description: Seconds to wait before retrying a failed call.

min_recv_speed.description: Minimum receive speed (bps) to accept in a T.30 negotiation.

max_recv_speed.description: Maximum receive speed (bps) to offer during T.30 negotiation.

resolution.description: Default scanning resolution: 'Fine' (204×196 dpi) or 'Normal' (204×98 dpi).

mail_host.description: SMTP server hostname for fax-to-email delivery.

mail_from.description: Return-path/Sender address used in outgoing fax emails.

mail_to.description: Global fallback email address if recipient not found (optional).

t38_support.description: Enable T.38 fax-over-IP support (reliable over UDP).

t38_max_bit_rate.description: Maximum T.38 bit rate (bps) for fax-over-IP sessions.

device.description: Serial device path for the modem (e.g., /dev/ttyS0, /dev/ttyUSB0).

description.description: Optional human-readable label for identification (not parsed).

modems.description: List of modems attached to this server. One entry per physical or virtual modem.
